name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r2
slot_change_request: NEW leaf master of the split QUANT transport; slot in the HBM die contract requested from H-DIE (replaces the 453.6x345.6 monolith slot).

job.purpose: Native-audit successor of the closed ctl (capture 304.0 ps on 33 pins: cmd_src/cmd_dst/cmd_op/cmd_block feed the constant-port pack and range-check adders before the first flop). r2 registers every cmd_* bit at its pin (one capture flop, the only load of the pin; keep_pin_regs anchors it at the W face) and runs the unchanged controller from the registers: +1 edge on the whole controller, measured in the exact QUANT bench (TSPLIT=2 LG=2).

benches.name: QDQ_TSPLIT_exact
benches.cmd: IO_REGS=1 LG=2 TSPLIT=2 bash tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_static.sh {RUN}/bench_tsplit && cat {RUN}/bench_tsplit/m0.log

structural_change: Native-audit successor of the closed ctl (capture 304.0 ps on 33 pins: cmd_src/cmd_dst/cmd_op/cmd_block feed the constant-port pack and range-check adders before the first flop). r2 registers every cmd_* bit at its pin (one capture flop, the only load of the pin; keep_pin_regs anchors it at the W face) and runs the unchanged controller from the registers: +1 edge on the whole controller, measured in the exact QUANT bench (TSPLIT=2 LG=2).

reroute_reason.fix: local reset relay: rst_n drives only a 3-flop relay (async assert, synchronous release), every controller flop resets from the relay output; the only failing pin of the closed r2 view was rst_n (capture 213.8 ps)
